create_AppData: create an AppData instance with a max user count for the RearrangeV2 HITL application
review_AppData: review the AppData class which holds shared state including connected users for all HITL states
summarize_AppData: summarize the AppData class that manages connected user connections as a dict of ConnectionRecord objects
test_AppData: test the AppData class initialization to verify max_user_count and connected_users are set correctly
refactor_AppData: refactor the AppData class to add methods for adding and removing connected users
